definitions.explanation: Tea scented with jasmine flowers. A popular Chinese-origin tea widely drunk in Japan, especially in Okinawa, and commonly served at Chinese restaurants.

examples.japanese: ジャスミン{茶|ちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
ジャスミン{茶|ちゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よくて→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I like jasmine tea because it has a nice fragrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ジャスミン{茶|ちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
From English "jasmine" + ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ (tea). Also called {茉莉花茶|まつりかちゃ} in Chinese-derived terminology, though ジャスミン{茶|ちゃ} is far more common in everyday Japanese.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ジャスミン{茶|ちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to brew jasmine tea
- ジャスミン{茶|ちゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧: the fragrance of jasmine tea
- ⟦ペットボトル→ペットボトル：05605_pettobotoru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ジャスミン{茶|ちゃ}: bottled jasmine tea

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Okinawa, jasmine tea is known as さんぴん⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ and is the most popular everyday tea, served at restaurants and sold in vending machines. In mainland Japan, ジャスミン{茶|ちゃ} is strongly associated with Chinese cuisine and is commonly served at ⟦{中華|ちゅうか}→中華：11322_chuuka⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}{店|てん}→料理店：25626_ryouriten⟧.
